items.html: And indeed, immediately at the time of the restriction, which is the ascent of the light upward, before its coming out from the eyes, when the Nekudim had not yet been made, immediately the two discernments of the externality were darkened, for the inner light was to depart upward; and they could not stand there, and they descended below, under the straight feet of Adam Kadmon — only to the place of the surrounding light which is beneath the straight feet of Adam Kadmon.
